title: Capacity for Inland Ash Scattering as Main Method of Managing Cremated Remains and Provision of Opt-out Option
what_it_is: Capacity for Inland Ash Scattering as Main Method of Managing Cremated Remains and Provision of Opt-out Option

sections.label: Inland Ash Scattering option
sections.summary: NEA has offered Inland Ash Scattering for cremated ashes since May 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the
sentences.text: Minister for Sustainability and the Environment): The National Environment Agency (NEA) has been offering Inland Ash Scattering (IAS) as an option for cremated ashes since May 2021.

sections.label: Second IAS facility Mandai
sections.summary: A second IAS facility, Garden of Serenity at the new Mandai Crematorium Complex, is scheduled to open in 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the
sentences.text: A second IAS facility, the Garden of Serenity at the new Mandai Crematorium Complex, is scheduled to be opened in 2025.

sections.label: IAS fees and uptake rates
sections.summary: There are no plans to make IAS the default; IAS costs about 40% less than a Government columbarium niche, with uptake rising from 7.1% in 2022 to 8.8% in 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the
sentences.text: Presently, we do not have any plans to make IAS the default option for managing cremated ashes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The current Garden of Peace will last us a couple of hundreds of years, but as I have said, the management of family members' cremated remains is a sensitive issue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Currently, the fee for the use of the IAS facility is cheaper.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: It is about 40% cheaper than buying a single niche in a Government columbarium.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, that would nudge the use of such a facility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: But even so, in 2022, only about 7.1% of residents whose religions do not require burial opted for IAS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: This has increased slightly to 8.8% in 2023.

sections.label: Community talks on IAS
sections.summary: The Minister would work with Ms Carrie Tan to host community talks promoting awareness of such options.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Indeed, I think we can tap on the community more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, I would be happy to work with Ms Carrie Tan to host such talks in her community and to promote the awareness of such options.
